**Answer.** A shoulder-wing glider spanning
[`{python} f"{b_proj*100:.1f}"` cm]{.key} tip to tip, on a
[`{python} f"{l_fus_m*100:.1f}"` cm]{.key} fuselage plate, with
[`{python} f"{dihedral:.1f}"`°]{.key} of dihedral (@fig-three-view). The flat
pattern you cut is wider, because bending the tips up shortens the span — the
dimension of this aircraft most easily got wrong.
